recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織被大片淡染、細胞質豐富呈灰藍泡沫/顆粒狀的巨噬細胞取代，缺乏典型壞死性肉芽腫；抗酸染色（Ziehl-Neelsen）可見巨噬細胞內塞滿大量紅色、彎曲且較長的桿菌，符合非典型分枝桿菌感染。
features: Bone marrow core with extensive sheet-like infiltrate of large histiocytes replacing hematopoietic tissue, adjacent fat spaces
Histiocytes with abundant pale gray-blue, finely granular/striated cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei; no well-formed epithelioid granulomas, caseation or giant cells
Scattered residual lymphocytes, plasma cells and hematopoietic cells between histiocytes
Ziehl-Neelsen stain: macrophages packed with innumerable magenta acid-fast bacilli, many long and curved, forming dense intracellular bundles
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm replacing much of the hematopoietic marrow. Well-formed epithelioid granulomas, necrosis and multinucleated giant cells are not identified. Ziehl-Neelsen stain demonstrates macrophages laden with innumerable acid-fast bacilli, many of which are elongated and curved. Findings are consistent with disseminated mycobacterial infection of the marrow, morphologically favoring atypical (nontuberculous) mycobacteria in an immunocompromised host; culture or molecular speciation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Typical TB in immunocompetent hosts forms epithelioid granulomas with caseous necrosis and scant bacilli, whereas here there are sheets of macrophages with enormous bacillary loads; speciation requires culture/PCR.
Gaucher cells show 'crinkled tissue-paper' cytoplasm that is PAS positive but acid-fast negative, whereas these histiocytes are stuffed with acid-fast bacilli.
These show small intracellular yeasts or amastigotes (GMS/Giemsa positive) rather than rod-shaped acid-fast bacilli.
Whipple macrophages contain PAS-positive diastase-resistant material but are not acid-fast, unlike mycobacteria.
